lifecycleEvidence.author: Teddy Woodward, Co-Founder and CEO
excerpts: On November 3rd, Notional V3 was impacted by a smart contract hack of Balancer V2. This incident led to significant losses for Notional users and ultimately a full wind-down of Notional V3.
Upon discovery of the issue, the Notional team disabled all Balancer vaults to guard against the possibility of any further losses and fully paused the protocol on Mainnet and Arbitrum.

After evaluating the extent of the damage, it was determined that it would not be possible to return Notional V3 to a functioning state in production. The team then decided that the best course of action would be to wind down Notional V3 and fully distribute all user funds.
The team is currently determining a path forward and will share details soon.
lifecycleEvidence.decision: Reject Mainnet and Arbitrum V3, including residual recovery/exit functions. No maintained successor deployment established.

lifecycleEvidence.excerpt: Notional V2 is being deprecated. Notional V3 is Live!
lifecycleEvidence.decision: V2 is not a maintained fallback.

limitations: Lifecycle gate failed before deployment/function admission; no implementation ABI was substituted or advertised. Historical marketing frontend and technical docs do not override explicit primary wind-down notice.
Future asset recovery is not a current maintained lending product. This does not assert that the team disbanded or that no future protocol could launch.
